quote: Silence speaks when words finally lose their meaning. You spend years building walls to protect your heart. Then one quiet moment tears them completely down. Sometimes the people who leave teach you the deepest truths. Memories linger long after the laughter has softly faded away. Let the broken pieces fall where they naturally belong. Peace finds you only when you stop fighting the tide.
